passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
Asaph wrote this psalm.

passages.text: The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm of Asaph.
Asaph speaks to God.
God owns an inheritance.
Nations have entered God’s inheritance.
The nations have invaded it.
The nations have defiled God’s holy temple.
The nations have made Jerusalem a heap of ruins.
Jerusalem now lies in rubble.
passages.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֡ים בָּ֤אוּ גוֹיִ֨ם׀ בְּֽנַחֲלָתֶ֗ךָ טִ֭מְּאוּ אֶת־ הֵיכַ֣ל קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לְעִיִּֽים׃

passages.text: They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.
passages.sermon:
The nations have attacked God's people.
They have killed God's servants.
They left the bodies of God's servants in the open.
Birds of the sky ate the corpses of God's servants.
They also killed God's faithful people.
Wild animals of the earth ate the flesh of God's faithful people.
passages.original: נָֽתְנ֡וּ אֶת־ נִבְלַ֬ת עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ מַ֭אֲכָל לְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּשַׂ֥ר חֲ֝סִידֶ֗יךָ לְחַיְתוֹ־ אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.
passages.sermon:
Foreign nations attacked God's people.
They killed many people in Jerusalem.
Blood covered the ground everywhere around the city.
No one buried the dead.
passages.original: שָׁפְכ֬וּ דָמָ֨ם׀ כַּמַּ֗יִם סְֽבִ֘יב֤וֹת יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם וְאֵ֣ין קוֹבֵֽר׃

passages.text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel suffered defeat and destruction.
Our neighbors now look down on us.
We have become a disgrace to them.
Those who live around us mock us.
They laugh at us and insult us.
passages.original: הָיִ֣ינוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The speaker asks a question.
The speaker says, “How long, O LORD?”
The speaker asks if the LORD will be angry forever.
The speaker asks if the LORD’s jealousy will burn like fire.
passages.original: עַד־ מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תֶּאֱנַ֣ף לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֥ר כְּמוֹ־ אֵ֝֗שׁ קִנְאָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, on the kingdoms that refuse to call on Your name, for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.
passages.sermon:
God, You are the Lord.
Some nations do not know You.
Some kingdoms do not call on Your name.
Pour out Your wrath on these nations.
Pour out Your wrath on these kingdoms.
They have devoured Jacob.
They have destroyed Jacob’s homeland.
passages.original: שְׁפֹ֤ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֨ אֶֽל־ הַגּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֪ר לֹא־ יְדָ֫ע֥וּךָ וְעַ֥ל מַמְלָכ֑וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃ כִּ֭י אָכַ֣ל אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְֽאֶת־ נָוֵ֥הוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ׃

passages.text: Do not hold past sins against us; let Your compassion come quickly, for we are brought low.
passages.sermon: God, do not remember our past sins.\r\nShow us Your compassion quickly.\r\nWe are very weak and humbled.
passages.original: אַֽל־ תִּזְכָּר־ לָנוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֪ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
passages.sermon:
God saves us.
God is our salvation.
We ask God to help us.
We ask God to help us because His name is glorious.
We ask God to deliver us.
We ask God to rescue us.
We ask God to forgive our sins.
We ask God to forgive us for the sake of His name.
passages.original: עָזְרֵ֤נוּ׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗נוּ עַל־ דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד־ שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְהַצִּילֵ֥נוּ וְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־ חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗ינוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to God.
The psalmist asks about the nations.
The nations are people who do not worship God.
The nations ask, “Where is their God?”
The psalmist does not want the nations to doubt God’s presence.
The psalmist asks God to act.
The psalmist asks God to show His power to the nations.
The psalmist wants God to do this while His people watch.
The psalmist asks God to show vengeance.
God’s vengeance is for the blood of His servants.
God’s servants have been killed.
The psalmist wants God to punish the nations for this bloodshed.
passages.original: לָ֤מָּה׀ יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִם֮ אַיֵּ֪ה אֱ‍ֽלֹהֵ֫יהֶ֥ם יִוָּדַ֣ע בַּגִּיִּים לְעֵינֵ֑ינוּ נִ֝קְמַ֗ת דַּֽם־ עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ הַשָּׁפֽוּךְ׃

passages.text: May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.
passages.sermon:
God listens to prayer.
God is strong.
Some people are captives.
These captives groan in their suffering.
Let their groans come before You, God.
Some people face death.
Use Your great power, God.
Save those who are condemned to die.
passages.original: תָּ֤ב֣וֹא לְפָנֶיךָ֮ אֶנְקַ֪ת אָ֫סִ֥יר כְּגֹ֥דֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ֑ ה֝וֹתֵ֗ר בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃

passages.text: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.
passages.sermon:
God, You are Lord.
Our neighbors have insulted You.
They have thrown reproach at You.
Return their reproach to them.
Give it back seven times over.
Place it in their own laps.
passages.original: וְהָ֘שֵׁ֤ב לִשְׁכֵנֵ֣ינוּ שִׁ֭בְעָתַיִם אֶל־ חֵיקָ֑ם חֶרְפָּ֘תָ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר חֵרְפ֣וּךָ אֲדֹנָֽי׃

passages.text: Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.
passages.sermon:
We are Your people.
We are the sheep of Your pasture.
We will thank You forever.
We will declare Your praise from generation to generation.
passages.original: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּךָ֨׀ וְצֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶךָ֮ נ֤וֹדֶ֥ה לְּךָ֗ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
